label: Co-possible Grim Reaper pieces along a populated descent glue into one possible world
paraphrase: OPEN analyst gluing premise, attribution deferred (Grim Reaper patchwork style): for the supplied station-register frame, in every history v accessible from the selected world, along every strictly descending sequence of moments c whose first moment has a contingent concrete individual present in v, if for every n some world accessible from v realizes the local pieces of stations n and n + 1 together, then some single world accessible from v realizes the local pieces of all stations along c. It asserts no piece is possible: in a beginningless history whose registers never host a piece it holds while pasts are neither founded nor begun. 'Concrete' is the supplied Concrete parameter; the Lean type does not enforce the esse reading.
